title: Invoking downsampling results in a security exception

labels.name: Team:Analytics
labels.description: Meta label for analytical engine team (ESQL/Aggs/Geo)

labels.name: :StorageEngine/Downsampling
labels.description: Downsampling (replacement for rollups) - Turn fine-grained time-based data into coarser-grained data

body:
Downsampling is broken. Not sure why yet (likely caused by #97557). Invoking the downsample api results into:
